elevate.move: Break the repeated text-left/card-right rhythm in the lower half: give each band its own geometry tied to a ticket part, e.g. the area band as a full-width route strip with the ZIP check inline on the rule, pricing as a full-bleed ledger with the headline set into the sheet header, and repairs as a single ruled work-code ledger instead of four boxed cards

Give the drawn plates a material that matches the ticket: a printed/risograph treatment (paper grain, slight ink misregistration, two-ink palette) so the illustrations read as diagrams printed on the job ticket rather than flat clip-art vectors
